subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: While the floor is clear, the lane classifier shall admit a proposal as an AUTO candidate only when its entire diff falls within the closed, versioned, operator-ratified set of AUTO-eligible change classes.
rationale: narrow positive classes, whole-diff (GATE-4 stage B)
fit_criterion: fixtures with any out-of-class hunk route HUMAN; the class set loads from versioned policy data only
